title: The Telangana Nurses, Midwives, Auxiliary Nurse-midwives and Health Visitors Act, 1926.
full_text: The Telangana Nurses, Midwives, Auxiliary Nurse-midwives and Health Visitors Act, 1926. Long Title: An Act for the registration of nurses and midwives in the State of Telangana.
